L01.edit: Replace stretched flip dispatch with nested horizontal-first tests.
L01.native_effect: Changes stretched real dispatch topology and predecessor order. Tests whether alias closure and allocation can change together without the historical one-shot wrapper. Nested tests eliminate one redundant logical decision on some paths; native register/live-block effects are uncertain.
L01.semantic_justification: All original arm payloads and SDK calls remain intact. The ordinary flag is stable until the selected arm stores its packet; every mask value selects the same original payload. No new loop, artificial pressure, qualifier, call, or macro change is introduced. Equivalence is limited to the pinned C defined domain; no native equivalence or match is claimed.
